lena: Hi folks, submitting my resignation today. Last day 2026-08-15. I'm in DE (Berlin). Quick Qs: health insurance end date, company pension (Direktversicherung) handling, and equipment return. cc @marco
marco (people-ops): Sad to see you go, Lena. For DE we usually keep company health top-up until month end of termination. Pension transfers need comp & payroll input. Will open ticket.
stef (manager): Can you keep 08/13-08/15 for KT? I'll collect laptop on 08/16 if that's easier.
lena: I prefer courier pickup on 08/16. Need email until 08/22 for handoffs.
tom (it): Standard plan: revoke admin keys on 08/16, SSO off 08/23, email off 08/23, slack off 08/18. We'll create pickup label.
hr-bot: [OFF-3001] Offboard ticket created for lena. Next: payroll to calculate final pay and pension instructions.
comp@redwood: We'll DM details about your option exercise window and pension portability.
lena: Thanks all — appreciate the help.
marco (people-ops): We'll attach COE and final docs to the ticket within 3 business days. Please fill the offboard form. :white_check_mark:
